company.name: AutoStream
company.description: A SaaS platform providing automated video editing tools for content creators using AI.

refund.description: Refunds are available within the first 7 days of purchase. No refunds after 7 days.

support.standard: Available on Basic plan during business hours

faq.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, upgrades take effect immediately and you are charged the prorated difference.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on all plans, which acts as a risk-free trial.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream works for creators on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter/X, and more.

faq.question: What video formats are supported?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV as input and exports in MP4.
